mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a course that gives you a good understanding of the care and management of cattle, sheep and goats."
Ruminant Animal Production is a course that gives you a good understanding of the care and management of cattle, sheep and goats.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous assessment component of your course."
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the sum total of the chemical and biochemical reactions occurring in each cell and therefore in the entire animal."
Metabolism refers to the sum total of the chemical and biochemical reactions occurring in each cell and therefore in the entire animal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the main contributors to protein breakdown, but protozoa and fungi may also play a role."
The bacteria are the main contributors to protein breakdown, but protozoa and fungi may also play a role.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fourth or true stomach of ruminants."
Displaced Abomasum The Abomasum is the fourth or true stomach of ruminants.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the lowest cost formula that contains all the nutritional elements needed for maximum/optimum performance."
The least cost ration is the lowest cost formula that contains all the nutritional elements needed for maximum/optimum performance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a condensation product of urea."
Biuret is a condensation product of urea.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the chief element which distinguishes proteins from carbohydrates and fats."
Nitrogen is the chief element which distinguishes proteins from carbohydrates and fats.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important aspect of animal production."
Diet formulation is an important aspect of animal production.
